meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed the published article body search and passage selectors, exact slug and Blog module checks, and trace allowlist for excerpt and revision hashes and numeric section index.

auth.review_note: Checked published article module gates and booking session ownership against authenticated controller boundaries and backend skill guidance.

commerce.review_note: Verified campaign booking capture and independent shop order handling against the backend skill and confirmed that article passage routing changes neither boundary.

content.review_note: Checked the combined authored-campaign publication and exact article passage guides against their distinct PHP page and published blog sources.

foundation.review_note: Cross-reviewed the schema and deployment instructions for campaign payments and the bounded article source identifiers and content. The hosted booking and private trace records keep their separate stores.

google-tags.review_note: Rechecked the current Site analytics, Google reporting and integration routes inherited from the merged base. Campaign booking changes add no tag or reporting behavior.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed booking failure handling and article result errors against the existing private response and no-partial-output boundaries.

interface.review_note: Reviewed the independent amount toggle, disabled preview, keyboard booking review, and private pending and captured cards against Design and the browser fixtures.

mail.review_note: Checked the published article gates and booking records against existing mail flow guidance. Article discovery and payment setup do not enqueue publication or payment messages.

mcp-clients.review_note: Reviewed local CLI and remote client guidance. Adding the isolated public search fixture to the CI command keeps existing client setup and capability contracts intact.

media.review_note: Checked retained campaign file descriptors and protected streaming against Media Library behavior. Booking authorization is scoped to the frozen private manifest.

operator-help.review_note: Reviewed the private booking help dependencies and public article gateways together. The PHP agent source remains limited to published customer articles.

public-mcp.review_note: Confirmed the published knowledge adapter retains its bounded metadata response while agent-only reads return article passages through their fixed tool declaration.

remote-commerce.review_note: Checked that link creation and verified captured payments retain their existing routes, provider references and booking state recovery after combining the backend guidance.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the CLI skill change with the Google sales-channel test and API requirements. The extra fixture covers local storefront search parity and calls no vendor service.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the reconciled backend skill and existing CI and generated inventory documentation. Both deposits of source changes keep their original tracked tests.
